facts.fact: CPJ cites sections 27(b) and 24(2)(a) of Nigeria's Cybercrimes Act as the basis of charges against two journalists.
CPJ says a federal court in Abuja on 10 November 2026 remanded journalist Daniel Ojukwu on 12 counts including charges under sections 27(b) and 24(2)(a) of the Cybercrimes Act.
